tokens.v: The jar sits at the edge of a travertine spa ledge beside a stack of folded ivory linen towels, steam drifting slowly off thermal water just behind, morning sun entering low and raking the stone so its pores throw grain-level shadows. 85mm at f/2.5 level with the lid, the brushed-brass catching one soft window of light, the frosted glass going luminous where the steam crosses behind it. SOLENNE reads screen-printed matte white on the band, clean and legible. A wet stone lip blurs across the bottom-left corner, cut by both edges; the pool's turquoise falls out of focus above.
